reports.title: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Portfolio Execution

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: ● | Kiniksa expects 2026 ARCALYST net product revenue of between $1.045 billion and $1.050 billion, compared to prior guidance of between $980 million and $995 million.
● | Kiniksa expects 2026 R&D expenses of between $160 million and $170 million and 2026 SG&A expenses of between $270 million and $280 million.
● | Kiniksa expects its current operating plan to remain cash flow positive on an annual basis.
